output.feedback: 1. Judgment 5: The FishSticks description reads "Imports a classroom's weekly word-list PDFs and turns them into spelling practice kids actually finish." The records say it reads PDFs from school, finds the bold words teachers use, and pairs voice pronunciation with adaptive quiz modes so kids can practice independently. Nothing in the records supports "weekly" or "kids actually finish." Rewrite the line from the record's approach and outcome text, for example "Thousands of kids practicing daily

The page commits to its one quiet line. Lowercase light Spectral italic owns the first fold, centred at both widths, with the amber 42 and the hairline under "five." Below it a slanted amber field carries the low-sun diagonal into the flooded colophon band. The work index, today's facts and the small-caps footer list all follow the declared order and the work records.
